skirmish.module.toggle_sprint.name: Toggle sprint
skirmish.module.toggle_sprint.descriptio: Turns on vanilla's toggle sprint (Controls → "Sprint: Toggle"): press the sprint key once and sprinting stays on. Your previous setting comes back when the module is turned off. The mod never presses anything itself.
skirmish.module.toggle_sprint.setting.in: Small pill in the bottom-left corner while toggled sprint is on
